data.gender_notes: Ijeoma is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ijeoma is a name of Igbo origin, derived from the Igbo language spoken in Nigeria. The name Ijeoma means 'God's goodness'. It is a name given to a child as a sign of God's favor and blessings. The name Ijeoma carries the meaning “God's goodness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Igbo. Parents who choose Ijeoma usually hope their child will grow to embody god's goodness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's constant goodness and grace.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ijeoma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אייג'אומה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אייג'אומה מקורו בשפה האיגבו, אך ניתן לפרש אותו באמצעות שורשים עבריים. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'אלוהים' (ה' הוא ישועתנו) ו-'ישועת' (ישועת אלוהים). השם מבטא את האמונה בה' כמקור הישועה והצלה.

in_greek.name: Ιτζεόμα
in_greek.meaning: Θεός εστι σωτηρία μου, Σωτηρία Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιτζεόμα προέρχεται από την ιγκμπο γλώσσα, αλλά μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί μέσω ελληνικών ριζών. Είναι σύνθεση δύο λέξεων: 'Θεός' (ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου) και 'σωτηρία' (σωτηρία Θεού). Το όνομα εκφράζει την πίστη στον Θεό ως πηγή σωτηρίας και διάσωσης.

in_latin.name: Ijeoma

in_latin.long_meaning: The name Ijeoma originates from the Igbo language, but can be interpreted through Latin roots. It is a combination of two words: 'Deus' (God is our salvation) and 'salus' (salvation of God). The name expresses faith in God as the source of salvation and deliverance.

in_english.name: Ijeoma
in_english.meaning: God is my salvation, God's salvation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ijeoma originates from the Igbo language, spoken in Nigeria. It is derived from two words: 'Chi' (God) and 'oma' (my good, my salvation). The name expresses the belief in God as the source of salvation, goodness, and deliverance. Although not directly found in the Bible, the name's meaning aligns with biblical themes of trusting in God for salvation (Psalm 27:1, Isaiah 12:2). In Christian tradition, Ijeoma symbolizes faith, trust, and reliance on God's providence.

The name Ijeoma reflects the strong faith and spiritual connection of the Igbo people to their deity.
